messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: It may increase the risk of pre-eclampsia.
It may increase the risk of stillbirth.
It may increase the risk of premature birth.
Untreated hypothyroidism can affect the baby's brain development.
The benefit of treating hypothyroidism outweighs these risks.
Levothyroxine should not be stopped during pregnancy.
Your dose needs are often higher during pregnancy.
Your doctor will check your thyroid blood tests as soon as your pregnancy is confirmed.
Your doctor will check your thyroid blood tests at least once in each trimester.
Your doctor will usually put you back on your pre-pregnancy dose straight after you give birth.
Your doctor will perform another blood test 4 to 8 weeks later.
Tell your doctor if you are breastfeeding.
Levothyroxine passes into breast milk.
No harmful effects on breastfed babies have been reported.
Treating hypothyroidism properly may help milk supply.
This may happen if Levothyroxine is low.
Your dose needs may be different while you are nursing.
You may be more likely to have a broken bone while using levothyroxine.
Triples: [["Levothyroxine", "increases risk of", "pre-eclampsia"], ["Levothyroxine", "increases risk of", "stillbirth"], ["Levothyroxine", "increases risk of", "premature birth"], ["Untreated hypothyroidism", "affects", "baby's brain development"], ["Treating hypothyroidism", "has benefit over", "risks"], ["Levothyroxine", "should not be stopped in", "pregnancy"], ["Levothyroxine", "has higher dose requirement in", "pregnancy"], ["Doctor", "checks thyroid blood tests after", "pregnancy confirmed"], ["Doctor", "checks thyroid blood tests at least once in", "each trimester"], ["Doctor", "resumes pre pregnancy dose after", "childbirth"], ["Doctor", "performs blood test 4 to 8 weeks after", "childbirth"], ["Doctor", "should be informed if", "breastfeeding"], ["Levothyroxine", "passes into", "breast milk"], ["Levothyroxine", "has no harmful effects on", "breastfed babies"], ["Proper treatment of hypothyroidism", "helps", "milk supply"], ["Low Levothyroxine", "may cause", "low milk supply"], ["Levothyroxine", "has different dose requirement in", "nursing"], ["Levothyroxine", "increases risk of", "broken bone"]]
Relations: ["affects", "checks thyroid blood tests after", "checks thyroid blood tests at least once in", "has benefit over", "has different dose requirement in", "has higher dose requirement in", "has no harmful effects on", "helps", "increases risk of", "may cause", "passes into", "performs blood test 4 to 8 weeks after", "resumes pre pregnancy dose after", "should be informed if", "should not be stopped in"]
Answer:

completion:
affects: The subject condition or action has an impact on the development or function specified by the object entity.  
checks thyroid blood tests after: The subject entity (usually a doctor) performs the specified medical test after the event or condition specified by the object entity.  
checks thyroid blood tests at least once in: The subject entity (usually a doctor) performs the specified medical test at least once during the time period or stage specified by the object entity.  
has benefit over: The subject action or treatment provides a positive outcome that outweighs the risks specified by the object entity.  
has different dose requirement in: The subject drug requires a different dosage compared to usual in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.  
has higher dose requirement in: The subject drug requires a higher dosage compared to usual in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.  
has no harmful effects on: The subject drug does not cause harmful effects on the entity or condition specified by the object entity.  
helps: The subject action or treatment contributes positively to the outcome or function specified by the object entity.  
increases risk of: The subject drug or condition increases the likelihood of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.  
may cause: The subject condition or action can lead to the adverse effect or outcome specified by the object entity.  
passes into: The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or system specified by the object entity.  
performs blood test 4 to 8 weeks after: The subject entity (usually a doctor) performs the specified medical test at the time interval specified by the object entity.  
resumes pre pregnancy dose after: The subject entity (usually a doctor) returns the patient to their pre-pregnancy medication dosage after the event specified by the object entity.  
should be informed if: The subject entity (usually a patient) needs to inform the object entity (usually a doctor) about the condition or situation specified.  
should not be stopped in: The subject drug should not be discontinued during the condition or situation specified by the object entity.
